_comment: The fells beyond the map edge (scripts/view/backdrop_renderer.gd, In-The-Nature look pass 2026-09-07). Presentation only: a ring of low-poly hills outside the playable terrain so the dale has a horizon instead of ending in nothing. The inner edge meets the terrain's own edge height and blends into noise-shaped fells over blend_m; the rise climbs from rise_min_m to rise_max_m by outer_radius_m. Heights in metres. Colours are palette keys, by height: low on the near slopes, high on the tops, rock above rock_from_m. The noise is FastNoiseLite with a fixed seed, so a rebuild is identical.
